verses: I also saw the soul of a man whose body remains set into a brazen cauldron; and they ever cook it. One foot, which is the right one, remained outside the cauldron.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this body?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked man who, among the living, lustfully and improperly, went much out to married women; and his whole body became sinful. But that right foot, the frog and ant, snake and scorpion, and other noxious creatures (khrafstars) were much smitten and killed and destroyed.'
